    function buildRimWorldColonist(preset) {
      const group = new THREE.Group();

      const matSkin = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: preset.skinColor || '#e0b18d',
        secondaryColor: '#c99773',
        strokeStyle: 'directional',
        strokeCount: 220
      });

      const matShirt = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: preset.shirtColor || '#3b6e8c',
        secondaryColor: preset.shirtSecondary || '#2c556e',
        strokeStyle: 'wavy',
        strokeCount: 320
      });

      const matOuterwear = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: preset.coatColor || '#70482c',
        secondaryColor: preset.coatSecondary || '#57361f',
        strokeStyle: 'coarse',
        strokeCount: 360
      });

      const matPants = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: preset.pantsColor || '#3c424a',
        secondaryColor: '#2b3036',
        strokeStyle: 'directional',
        strokeCount: 260
      });

      const matHair = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: preset.hairColor || '#4a3222',
        secondaryColor: '#332115',
        strokeStyle: 'wavy',
        strokeCount: 240
      });

      const matHat = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: preset.hatColor || '#8c5832',
        secondaryColor: '#6e4323',
        strokeStyle: 'directional',
        strokeCount: 260
      });

      const matWeaponWood = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: '#7d4e2d',
        secondaryColor: '#5c371e',
        strokeStyle: 'directional',
        strokeCount: 180
      });

      const matSteelGouache = registerGouacheMat({
        baseColor: '#6c767d',
        secondaryColor: '#4c5459',
        accentColor: '#909ca3',
        strokeStyle: 'directional',
        strokeCount: 220
      });

      const hipY = 0.56;

      const torsoGeo = createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.46, 0.30, 0.52, 0.34, 0.64, 0, 0);
      const torso = createCardboardPart(torsoGeo, matShirt, {
        pos: [0, hipY + 0.32, 0]
      });
      group.add(torso);

      if (preset.role === 'sheriff') {
        const coatLeft = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.14, 0.34, 0.18, 0.40, 0.72, 0, 0),
          matOuterwear,
          { pos: [-0.19, hipY + 0.28, 0] }
        );
        const coatRight = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.14, 0.34, 0.18, 0.40, 0.72, 0, 0),
          matOuterwear,
          { pos: [0.19, hipY + 0.28, 0] }
        );
        const coatBack = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.48, 0.10, 0.56, 0.14, 0.72, 0, 0),
          matOuterwear,
          { pos: [0, hipY + 0.28, -0.14] }
        );
        const bandanaMat = registerGouacheMat({
          baseColor: '#b83228',
          secondaryColor: '#8f2219',
          strokeStyle: 'directional',
          strokeCount: 140
        });
        const bandana = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.34, 0.32, 0.16, 0.20, 0.14, 0, 0.04),
          bandanaMat,
          { pos: [0, hipY + 0.62, 0.04] }
        );
        group.add(coatLeft, coatRight, coatBack, bandana);
      } else if (preset.role === 'guard') {
        const flakVest = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.52, 0.38, 0.50, 0.36, 0.48, 0, 0),
          matOuterwear,
          { pos: [0, hipY + 0.36, 0] }
        );
        [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
          const pad = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.20, 0.14, 0.32), matOuterwear, {
            pos: [side * 0.28, hipY + 0.56, 0],
            rot: [0, 0, -side * 0.2]
          });
          group.add(pad);
        });
        group.add(flakVest);
      } else if (preset.role === 'miner') {
        const pack = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.38, 0.44, 0.22), matOuterwear, {
          pos: [0, hipY + 0.34, -0.24]
        });
        const bedroll = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.42, 0.14, 0.14), matHat, {
          pos: [0, hipY + 0.60, -0.24]
        });
        group.add(pack, bedroll);
      } else if (preset.role === 'medic') {
        const coatHem = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.50, 0.34, 0.56, 0.38, 0.28, 0, 0),
          matShirt,
          { pos: [0, hipY + 0.06, 0] }
        );
        const crossMat = registerGouacheMat({
          baseColor: '#c93429',
          secondaryColor: '#9e231b',
          strokeStyle: 'directional',
          strokeCount: 120
        });
        const badgeH = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14, 0.05, 0.03), crossMat, {
          pos: [-0.11, hipY + 0.46, 0.16]
        });
        const badgeV = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.14, 0.03), crossMat, {
          pos: [-0.11, hipY + 0.46, 0.16]
        });
        group.add(coatHem, badgeH, badgeV);
      }

      const headGroup = new THREE.Group();
      headGroup.position.set(0, hipY + 0.66, 0);
      group.add(headGroup);

      const headBox = createCardboardPart(
        createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.36, 0.36, 0.33, 0.33, 0.38, 0, 0),
        matSkin,
        { pos: [0, 0.20, 0] }
      );
      headGroup.add(headBox);

      const nose = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06, 0.08, 0.06), matSkin, {
        pos: [0, 0.19, 0.19]
      });
      headGroup.add(nose);

      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        const eye = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.03), matCharcoalGouache, {
          pos: [side * 0.09, 0.22, 0.18]
        });
        const ear = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.10, 0.07), matSkin, {
          pos: [side * 0.19, 0.20, 0]
        });
        headGroup.add(eye, ear);
      });

      if (preset.role === 'sheriff') {
        const brim = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.66, 0.05, 0.62), matHat, {
          pos: [0, 0.39, 0],
          rot: [-0.04, 0, 0]
        });
        const crown = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.32, 0.34, 0.38, 0.40, 0.22, 0, -0.02),
          matHat,
          { pos: [0, 0.51, 0] }
        );
        headGroup.add(brim, crown);
      } else if (preset.role === 'miner') {
        const beard = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.36, 0.24, 0.26, 0.16, 0.18, 0, 0.03),
          matHair,
          { pos: [0, 0.08, 0.11] }
        );
        const dome = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.32, 0.34, 0.42, 0.44, 0.18, 0, 0),
          matHat,
          { pos: [0, 0.44, 0] }
        );
        const lamp = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.10, 0.09, 0.08), matCreamWhiteGouache, {
          pos: [0, 0.46, 0.22]
        });
        headGroup.add(beard, dome, lamp);
      } else if (preset.role === 'medic') {
        const hairTop = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.40, 0.14, 0.40), matHair, {
          pos: [0, 0.38, -0.02]
        });
        const hairBun = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.20, 0.20, 0.18), matHair, {
          pos: [0, 0.36, -0.26]
        });
        const glassesBridge = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.28, 0.03, 0.03), matCharcoalGouache, {
          pos: [0, 0.23, 0.20]
        });
        headGroup.add(hairTop, hairBun, glassesBridge);
      } else if (preset.role === 'guard') {
        const helmet = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.36, 0.38, 0.44, 0.44, 0.24, 0, -0.02),
          matHat,
          { pos: [0, 0.42, -0.01] }
        );
        const visor = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.38, 0.08, 0.06), matCharcoalGouache, {
          pos: [0, 0.28, 0.20]
        });
        headGroup.add(helmet, visor);
      }

      const leftArmPivot = new THREE.Group();
      leftArmPivot.position.set(-0.32, hipY + 0.56, 0);
      const rightArmPivot = new THREE.Group();
      rightArmPivot.position.set(0.32, hipY + 0.56, 0);
      group.add(leftArmPivot, rightArmPivot);

      [leftArmPivot, rightArmPivot].forEach((pivot, idx) => {
        const sleeveMat = preset.role === 'sheriff' ? matOuterwear : matShirt;
        const upperArm = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.15, 0.15, 0.13, 0.13, 0.28, 0, 0),
          sleeveMat,
          { pos: [0, -0.12, 0] }
        );
        const hand = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12, 0.12, 0.12), matSkin, {
          pos: [0, -0.30, 0]
        });
        pivot.add(upperArm, hand);

        if (idx === 1) {
          if (preset.role === 'sheriff' || preset.role === 'guard') {
            pivot.rotation.x = -0.65;
            const stock = createCardboardPart(
              new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.08, 0.14, 0.56),
              preset.role === 'guard' ? matCharcoalGouache : matWeaponWood,
              { pos: [0, -0.30, 0.18] }
            );
            const barrel = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.05, 0.06, 0.46), matSteelGouache, {
              pos: [0, -0.26, 0.52]
            });
            pivot.add(stock, barrel);
          } else if (preset.role === 'miner') {
            pivot.rotation.x = -0.5;
            const handle = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06, 0.06, 0.62), matWeaponWood, {
              pos: [0, -0.30, 0.18]
            });
            const pickHead = createCardboardPart(
              createTaperedBoxGeometry(0.44, 0.08, 0.08, 0.35, 0.5, 0),
              matSteelGouache,
              { pos: [0, -0.30, 0.46], rot: [0, 0, Math.PI * 0.5] }
            );
            pivot.add(handle, pickHead);
          } else if (preset.role === 'medic') {
            const medBox = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.12, 0.24, 0.30), matCreamWhiteGouache, {
              pos: [0.06, -0.38, 0.04]
            });
            pivot.add(medBox);
          }
        }
      });

      const legs = [];
      [-1, 1].forEach((side) => {
        const legPivot = new THREE.Group();
        legPivot.position.set(side * 0.13, hipY, 0);

        const trouser = createCardboardPart(
          createVerticalPrismGeometry(0.20, 0.22, 0.17, 0.19, 0.42, 0, 0),
          matPants,
          { pos: [0, -0.21, 0] }
        );
        const boot = createCardboardPart(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.18, 0.15, 0.25), matCharcoalGouache, {
          pos: [0, -0.48, 0.03]
        });
        legPivot.add(trouser, boot);
        group.add(legPivot);
        legs.push(legPivot);
      });

      group.userData = {
        headGroup,
        leftArmPivot,
        rightArmPivot,
        legs,
        primaryMaterial: preset.role === 'sheriff' || preset.role === 'guard' ? matOuterwear : matShirt
      };
      return group;
    }
